entities.name: Query protein
observations: 330 aa protein with predicted molecular mass 35.55 kDa and theoretical pI 5.24.
Best reviewed homolog is Aquifex aeolicus O67716, with 52.2% identity and 99.1% query coverage.
Additional reviewed homologs Q59291 and Q04797 are aspartate-semialdehyde dehydrogenases with about 47% identity and 96–98% coverage.

entities.name: Aspartate-semialdehyde dehydrogenase
observations: The sequence is strongly supported as an aspartate-semialdehyde dehydrogenase, EC 1.2.1.11, based on high-coverage homology to reviewed proteins and matching Pfam domains.
The enzyme catalyzes NADPH-dependent reductive dephosphorylation of 4-phospho-L-aspartate to L-aspartate 4-semialdehyde.
Reference proteins are annotated as homodimers and cytosolic enzymes.

entities.name: Aspartate-family amino acid biosynthesis
observations: Aspartate-semialdehyde dehydrogenase supplies L-aspartate 4-semialdehyde for lysine, methionine, threonine, and homoserine biosynthesis in reference annotations.

entities.name: RHEA:24284
observations: Reference reaction: L-aspartate 4-semialdehyde + phosphate + NADP(+) = 4-phospho-L-aspartate + NADPH + H(+), with direction represented reversibly in the retrieved annotation.
